input: Assembly accessions, sample/culture keys, current BUSCO and assembly QC; type references
action: Resolve duplicate sequence hashes versus biological replicates; include missing public genomes only after QC. Obtain verified type genomes for terreus and montoensis; broaden section-wide sampling.
output: Frozen training/holdout panel and provenance manifest; explicit exclusions.
criterion: Unique sequence identity and culture identity separately tracked; no confident species scheme for unresolved assignments.

input: Genome FASTA + harmonized fungal GFF3/CDS/protein files
action: Validate coordinate-consistent exon-joined CDS, translation, genetic code, internal stops and one representative isoform per gene. Distinguish missing assembly sequence from failed annotation.
output: Versioned fungal CDS and protein catalog with per-locus callability codes.
criterion: Fungal annotation pipeline validated across assembly sources; protein-only/transcript-only data cannot by themselves supply comparable nucleotide genome alleles.

action: Review orthology with protein trees, duplication histories, reciprocal matches and synteny. Screen paralogs, repeats and unstable models. Re-evaluate on a species-balanced independent panel.
output: Candidate loci with stable IDs, coordinates, copy-state evidence and exclusions.
criterion: Exactly one defensible ortholog per callable genome; copy count alone is insufficient.

input: Validated loci and representative diversity panel
action: Pilot exon-joined nucleotide CDS alleles using chewBBACA CDS mode or a validated allele catalog/caller. Benchmark intron handling against curated loci. Keep intronic genomic haplotypes as a separately named optional analysis.
output: Reproducible allele sequences, hashes and immutable allele IDs; schema version and allele profiles.
criterion: No arbitrary paralog selection; missing, ambiguous, truncated and multicopy calls remain distinct from valid allele IDs.

input: Validated section-wide catalog and defensible species groups
action: Define a stable section-wide backbone plus species-specific extensions. Retain global locus identifiers and version membership lists. Compare 95%, 99% and 100% occupancy thresholds on training data.
output: Section backbone and nested species views/extensions; no silently changing core.
criterion: Thresholds are proposed pilot settings, selected using holdout callability and stability, not declared universal fungal standards.

input: Independent holdout genomes, alternate assemblies/platforms and technical replicates
action: Measure allele-call reproducibility, dropout, discrimination, saturation and agreement with validated core SNP/phylogenomic relationships. Test annotation-version sensitivity and species imbalance.
output: Validation report, failure matrix and minimum-callability policy.
criterion: Report differences/shared callable loci per pair; no missing-as-zero distance, no universal outbreak cutoff without empirical validation.

input: Frozen allele catalog and validation evidence
action: Package allele nomenclature, schema changelog, test panel and reproducible caller. Keep lovastatin architecture/phenotypes as accessory traits for structure-aware evolutionary analyses.
output: Research cgMLST release and reproducible profiles, with optional later public registry submission.
criterion: Research pilot clearly separated from externally validated nomenclature; ecological or clinical thresholds require independent evidence.
